meta.title: CompanyHub Application Flows
meta.description: Complete documentation of all user flows, data models, and architecture for CompanyHub - an internal web dashboard for Control Service Company.

architecture.backend: None  -  all data in browser localStorage

sharedInfrastructure.css: site-ui.css (also copy-pasted inline into each HTML <style id='site-ui-styles'>)
sharedInfrastructure.js: site-ui.js (Store, DashboardController, theme, backup, settings, clock)
sharedInfrastructure.feedbackWidget: feedback-widget.css + inline JS in HTML files

pages.title: Dashboard
pages.description: Main landing page with company-wide metrics, department navigation, calendar widget, notifications, and settings.

flows.name: Authentication
flows.description: Two-path login: Microsoft 365 SSO (MSAL popup) or Demo mode. Session stored in sessionStorage as ch_user. Auto-login on page refresh if session exists.
steps: Page loads, checks sessionStorage for ch_user
If session exists → enterApp() immediately (auto-login)
If no session → show login screen
User clicks 'Sign in with Microsoft' → MSAL popup OAuth
On success → save user object to sessionStorage, call enterApp()
On MSAL fail with dummy clientId → auto-fallback to demo mode
enterApp() hides login, shows app, populates topbar user chip

flows.name: Dashboard Metric Cards
flows.description: Four stat cards showing company-wide numbers, plus two department cards and eight quick-access cards. Stats pull from localStorage keys written by other pages.
steps: On page load, read sv_staffData, sv_saData, en_projects from localStorage
Populate stat cards with counts (fallback to defaults if empty)
Department cards link to service-department.html and energy-department.html
Quick-access cards link to specific views within those pages

flows.name: Calendar & Events
flows.description: Mini calendar with event markers from three sources. Shows upcoming events list (top 5).
steps: On page load, call getUpcomingEvents() to aggregate from 3 localStorage sources
Render calendar grid with colored dots on event days
Show top 5 upcoming events in sidebar list
Month navigation with calNav(dir)

flows.name: Notifications Panel
flows.description: Persistent notification system with localStorage backing. Bell icon in topbar with badge count and dropdown panel.

flows.name: Settings Modal
flows.description: Overlay modal for theme (dark/light), accent color (8 presets + custom hex), default login page, and feedback mode toggle. Dynamically built on first load.
sections: Accent Color: 8 presets + custom hex picker
Default Login Screen: Dashboard / Service / Energy

flows.name: Backup / Restore / Reset
flows.description: Full localStorage export to JSON file, restore from JSON, and reset all data. Buttons in sidebar bottom.

details.resetBehavior: Clears both localStorage AND sessionStorage, reloads page

flows.name: Navigation System
flows.description: Topbar brand + department tabs, sidebar with view switching, and cross-page links via hrefs.
sidebarSections: Service: Personnel, PM Schedule, Dispatch Board
Energy: PDF/OCR, Weather Normalize, Baseline, Energy Savings, WebCTRL

pages.title: Energy Department
pages.description: Energy department tool: project management, utility bill data entry, PDF OCR extraction, weather normalization, equipment tracking, baseline/savings calculations, and report generation. ~13,000 lines.

flows.name: Project Management
flows.description: CRUD for energy projects. Each project contains buildings, which contain meters, which contain bills.

flows.name: Building Management
flows.description: Multi-building per project. Each building has a name, address, square footage, and ZIP code (for weather data matching).

flows.name: Meter Management
flows.description: Multiple meters per building. Commodity types determine available units. Meters hold bills and optional baseline regressions.

flows.name: Utility Bill Data Entry
flows.description: Manual bill entry per meter with dynamic fields based on commodity type. Also supports CSV import and audit logging.

flows.name: PDF OCR Extraction Engine
flows.description: Two-stage pipeline: PDF.js text extraction first (fast, digital PDFs), falls back to Tesseract.js OCR if text < 100 chars (scanned PDFs). Rule-based extraction via UTILITY_RULES array. 100% local, no AI.
steps: User uploads PDF via file input
PDF.js extracts text from each page
If text < 100 chars on a page → Tesseract.js OCR that page
Combined text passed through UTILITY_RULES detect() functions
First matching rule's extract() or extractAll() runs
Extracted fields shown for review
Duplicate detection: compare against existing bills
User can overwrite, merge, or skip duplicates per field
Assign extracted data to project > building > meter

utilityRules.name: Evergy
utilityRules.detect: Matches 'Billing Details - service from MM/DD/YYYY to MM/DD/YYYY' patterns
features: Fuzzy date-pair merge for OCR-garbled dates

utilityRules.name: Gas Utilities (Spire, Laclede, Kansas Gas, Atmos, Black Hills)
utilityRules.detect: Natural gas bill signatures (therms, CCF, gas utility names)

utilityRules.name: City of Louisburg (Municipal Multi-Utility)
features: extractAll() splits one page into multiple bills
Gas rate corrections with historical rate tables

utilityRules.name: Generic Fallback
utilityRules.detect: Any document with cost + usage patterns (must stay last in array)

flows.name: Weather Normalization
flows.description: Upload weather data CSV by ZIP code. Used in ASHRAE Guideline 14 baseline calculations to adjust consumption for weather variations.

flows.name: Equipment Tracking
flows.description: Track equipment per project: AHUs, RTUs, boilers, chillers, VAVs, etc.

flows.name: Baseline & Savings Calculations
flows.description: Compute baseline consumption, weather-normalized savings, EUI, and CSC compensation. Supports both Normalized and Actual baseline comparison modes.
flows.formula: (Baseline Usage - Actual Usage) x Current Rate, calculated monthly then summed

flows.name: Report Generation
flows.description: Generate quarterly or annual reports with selectable sections. Output as HTML pages with charts and tables. Export to PDF available.

pages.title: Service Department
pages.description: Service department dashboard: personnel management, PM scheduling calendar with natural-language pattern parsing, and technician dispatch board.

flows.name: Personnel Management
flows.description: Staff roster with status tracking (On Duty / Off / On Leave), filtering, and stats cards.

flows.name: PM Scheduling Calendar
flows.description: Preventative maintenance schedule with auto-generated dates from natural-language patterns (Column M from service agreements). Supports 10+ pattern types. Calendar shows colored dots per technician.
steps: Load service agreements from sv_saData
For each SA, parse pattern field through generateDatesForPattern(pattern, year)
Filter dates to contract start/end range
Render calendar grid with tech-colored event dots
Click day to see list of PM events
Click SA row to see detail panel with all generated dates

flows.name: Dispatch Board
flows.description: Work order management and technician assignments. Table view with status indicators.

flows.name: Microsoft 365 / Outlook Sync
flows.description: Sync upcoming PM events (next 30 days, max 5) to user's Outlook Calendar via Microsoft Graph API.
flows.details: Posts events to graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/events with title '[PM] Customer  -  SA# (Label)'

pages.title: EMS Leads
pages.description: Energy Management Sales lead/pipeline tracker with Kanban board, table view, follow-ups, analytics, CSV import/export, and activity logging.

flows.name: Pipeline Kanban Board
flows.description: Drag-and-drop Kanban board with 8 pipeline stages. Cards show company, location, priority, CSC contact, tags, value, next action, and overdue warnings.

flows.name: Lead CRUD Operations
flows.description: Create, read, update, delete leads. Detail drawer with 3 tabs: Overview (form), Activity Log, AI Tools (disabled).

flows.name: CSV Import
flows.description: Import leads from CSV with drag-drop or file picker. Auto-maps common column names. Preview before import. Currently creates separate leads (merge/skip modes planned).

flows.name: Multiple View Modes
flows.description: Four view modes accessible from sidebar: Pipeline (Kanban), All Leads (sortable table), Follow-ups (grouped by urgency), Analytics (summary stats and breakdowns).

views.name: All Leads
views.description: Sortable spreadsheet table with column sorting

views.name: Follow-ups
views.description: Leads grouped: Overdue (red), This Week (amber), No Date Set (blue)

views.name: Analytics
views.description: Total Pipeline Value, Won Revenue, Win Rate, Avg Deal Size, Stage/CSC/Type breakdowns

flows.name: Filtering, Sorting & Search
flows.description: Real-time search across company/city/contact/notes. Filter by stage, priority, CSC contact. Table supports column sorting (numeric + string).

flows.name: CSV Export
flows.description: Export all leads to CSV with 21 columns. Downloads as EMS-Leads-YYYY-MM-DD.csv.

flows.name: Activity Log
flows.description: Per-lead activity history. Add notes with timestamp and optional user. Auto-updates lastContact date.

store.description: Centralized data layer via Store object in site-ui.js. All CRUD operations go through Store, which fires dataUpdated CustomEvents for cross-page sync.

api.description: Read and parse JSON from localStorage, returns [] on failure
Write JSON to localStorage and fire dataUpdated event
Find item by id, merge newData, stamp updatedAt, save
Filter out item by id and save

dashboardController.description: Watches Store data and auto-updates dashboard metric cards. Listens for dataUpdated events, reads staff/SA/project counts.

api.description: Re-read all data sources and update stat card elements

themeSystem.description: CSS custom properties for all colors. Dark/light mode via data-theme attribute. Accent color user-customizable.

helpers.sset(key, value): Wrapper for Store.set() with fallback to raw localStorage
helpers.sget(key, fallback): Wrapper for Store.get() with fallback value

features: Mobile sidebar drawer with hamburger toggle

global.description: Theme, accent color, default login, feedback mode, UI customization

ems.description: EMS pipeline leads with activity logs

crossPageDataFlow.description: Each page reads from localStorage on load, writes back on mutation via Store.set() which fires dataUpdated events. Dashboard auto-refreshes metric cards. Backup/restore serializes entire localStorage to JSON.
pattern: Page load → sget(key) into local variables
User mutation → validate → sset(key, data) → fires dataUpdated event
DashboardController listens → refresh() updates stat cards
Backup → serialize all localStorage keys to JSON file
Restore → parse JSON, write all keys back, reload page
